WITH status_avg AS (
  SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS baseline
  FROM status_avg
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.avg_modelconf, s.avg_modelconf - o.baseline AS difference
  FROM status_avg AS s
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o
  WHERE s.avg_modelconf > o.baseline
),
filtered_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS avg_filtered
  FROM filtered
)
SELECT f.brokrepstat, f.avg_modelconf, f.difference,
       f.avg_modelconf / a.avg_filtered
FROM filtered AS f
CROSS JOIN filtered_avg AS a
